evidence: The paper states: "SVM-MOCCA lends itself more readily to model interpretation than does RF-MOCCA, as a linear or quadratic SVM kernel can be reformulated as feature or feature pair weights, respectively." Model evaluation focuses exclusively on cross-validated predictive accuracy: "RF-MOCCA yielded the best generalization performance to both PREs and BEs, with a 1.07-fold increase in the area under the Precision/Recall curve." All conclusions are performance-based, not importance-based.
